component.name: TextureCraft
component.summary: Paint PBR textures directly on 3D meshes

description.p: This is a community package of TextureCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the TextureCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.

TextureCraft is an open-source, native 3D texture painter written in Rust that follows the Substance 3D Painter workflow: familiar menus, shortcuts, panels and tools, with texture sets, layers, masks, fills and effects painted straight onto the model.

ul.li: Open glTF/GLB, FBX, COLLADA, USD (USDA/USDC/USDZ), Alembic, OBJ, PLY and STL meshes and save projects as .tcraft
Paint base colour, roughness, metallic, normal and height together with PBR brushes
Bake mesh maps and export texture sets as PNG, EXR, TGA, JPEG or TIFF
Every action is a command, scriptable from a CLI and a JSON control channel

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=texturecraft-cli ai.storyteller.texturecraft --help

Permissions: this package uses the same sandbox as upstream's own Flatpak manifest: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, and the Pictures and Documents folders. Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted.

ul.li: Let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.texturecraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder (command line, Open Recent): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.texturecraft
